pages.title: Network Overview
pages.text: Endfield Industry uses a Global Power Network Manager (singleton pattern) for cross-chunk, long-distance power transmission. The grid operates independently of chunk loading — power distribution continues even when you're far away.$(br2)Each dimension has its own independent grid instance.

pages.title: Node System
pages.text: The grid uses a node system for connection management:$(br)$(li)Core Node (CORE) — Protocol Core$(li)Relay Node (RELAY) — Relay Tower$(li)Pylon Node (PYLON) — Electric Pylon$(li)Consumer Node (CONSUMER) — powered devices$(br2)Maximum connection distance between nodes is 80 meters.

pages.title: Distribution Mechanism
pages.text: Every tick (1/20s), the network manager:$(br)1. Sums all generator output$(br)2. Sums all consumer demand$(br)3. Calculates supply ratio$(br)4. Distributes power proportionally$(br2)Surplus charges the Protocol Core battery; deficit draws from battery storage.
